notes.title: Update 01-08-2016
notes.content:
Dear Splooshies! 

Being a small indie studio, we were so busy with getting our Gold version out that we actually forgot telling you guys about it.

So as we are patching a few issues today, we use the opportunity to make up for it today:

INTO THE BELLY OF THE BEAST is not  in Early Access any more! 
The full game with all regions and the whole feature set is waiting for you! :)

Patch 1.8.2016 Changelog:

 "Immunity after death" time tweaked
 Wrong Achievement names fixed
 Some localization bugs fixed
 Bug in the "Lightfísh" level fixed
 "Roar of Beast" in Throat area tweaked
 Rare bug at Octokay Boss fight fixed
 Further performance optimization

notes.title: New content: Into the Lung of the Beast
notes.content:
Hey Guys,

today we released another update: we proudly introduce the region boss for the stomach region, the whole lung region and two new DNA abilities!

Enjoy exploring The Belly Of The Beast!

New content	Added Boss fight at the end of the stomach region	Added lung region with 6 new playable levels	Added a preview level for the end boss in the lung region	Added new visuals for the range visualization of the heat bomb	Added a new loading screen for the main menuGameplay changes	Enemy swarms now prevent the player from casting abilities while stunning the player	Swarms now react correctly to the player's DNA status	"Accept" using bite button should work in all menus now	Added clock ticking sounds and visuals to time-based puzzles	Adjusted spitter traps balancing	If the player fulfills the requirements for a health upgrade, any penalties will be cleared at that moment	The menu point "Back to Heart" is now only accessible after finishing the tutorial	Cool down added on elementpods	Rebalanced stun durations on enemies who are stunned by an electro bomb	Rebalanced the DNA-usage-buff from the yellow DNA collectablesBugfixes	Added missing sounds for some traps	Fixed a bug where respawning didn't work as intended	Fixed a bug where the swarm didn't stun Sploosh correctly	Fixed overlay issues in tutorial text	Fixed a bug where enemy worm could push buttons out of their anchors accidentaly	Fixed blowfish animations	Fixed a bug where selection sounds didn't appear in the in-game pause menu	Fixed a bug where the player could get stuck in one of the puzzle in the second stomach level	Fixed a bug where the player could get stuck while carrying a weighted ball
Localisation	Fixed bugs in the Spanish localisation

notes.content:

Changelog:


    Menu fixes
    Sound: (Skeleton props)
    Sound: Roar Event refinements
    Sound: Stun Sound
